title: Awwwards-quality Sites
concept: Vell Halo, a fictional benchtop live-cell imager: the hero is a microscope eyepiece where the whole slide reads as label-free phase contrast and a pointer-driven objective reveals the fluorescence channels, followed by a pinned, scrubbed fourteen-day confluence chart, instrument, workflow, channel list and a loan-unit request form.
notes: Three.js shader over a real confocal micrograph (Unsplash, copied locally) with one job: phase contrast outside the lens, magnified per-channel fluorescence inside; idle survey path, pointer/touch/arrow-key control, DPR cap 1.75, pauses offscreen/hidden, context-loss and reduced-motion fall back to a CSS-filtered poster with a static lens whose channels switch via SVG colour matrices. GSAP intro + word-staggered headings, Lenis as the only smooth-scroll engine wired to ScrollTrigger, one pinned scrub. Solar icons via iconify-icon (fetched from the Iconify API at runtime). Companion skill: animation-systems. No avatars, testimonials or logos: the brand is fictional and the curves are labelled illustrative.
